title: Chapter 494
paragraphs: Chapter 494
Episode 137. They all had good plans (5)
The Wraith Squad members were too far away to hear, but Black Knight Jane heard Jin's voice clearly.
"12th Rank, that's an inappropriate remark."
Jane said.
"Black Knight, please do not interfere. I do not wish to harm the black helmet dedicated to the family."
Jane's eyes behind the mask widened.
No one in the family had spoken to her like that since she became a Black Knight with Mon a year ago. However, it was not a situation where she could casually argue, citing etiquette and laws.
There was no justification, and four Wraith Squad members were attacking Jin in front of her.
'He knows that the 2nd Rank and I have been hiding information. Moreover, it's not a bluff or intimidation. If I don't reveal the location of the vault, he is really planning to kill the 2nd Rank.'
Throughout the time, Jin, whom Jane had observed and heard directly, was an unhesitant character. As he had just revealed himself, he never threw empty words.
-At first, it was suspicious that the 4th Rank and the 12th Rank were not sharing information about the second tower.
Mon's words came to mind. Although they didn't discuss it with Joshua at the time, both Mon and Jane were worried about Jin's behavior.
'Besides, what about the 4th Rank? If there's resentment towards the 2nd Rank, this side is much deeper. It could be really dangerous if we're not careful. Mon... should come.'
Although allies from Runcandel had arrived, Joshua and Jane felt even more pressure than when they were pushed back by the enemies earlier.
"Obstructing the mission?"
Jin's eyes darkened even more at Joshua's words.
"Your arm is still attached to your body because the enemies are in front of us. But if you give another meaningless answer next time, it will be cut off."

For Diphus, it was a scene he had only experienced thousands or tens of thousands of times in his imagination, except for his childhood when Luna was in her prime. It was when Joshua was cornered like this.
'It's been a long time since I've seen Joshua like this. It wouldn't be bad to kill him now, but I'd better watch my youngest brother's judgment.'
The Wraith Squad's attack resumed. Diphus, Jane, and Murakan blocked the barrage of magic, with Murakan refraining from using his energy as per Jin's instruction to hide his strength.
As a result, the Wraith Squad suspected Murakan to be one of Runcandel's Black Knights.
Amidst the noise of battle, Jin and Joshua's gazes collided.
"…It's on the 17th floor."
Eventually, Joshua answered and pulled out a piece of paper from his pocket, handing it over. It was a paper with the detailed locations and entry routes of the vault.
"That can't be all, 2nd Rank."
"What do you mean?"
"Means to ignore the barrier. Hand that over as well."
"There is no such thing."
"I thought you were quite intelligent, but you can't understand my words."
Swish! Clang-!
Jin swung his sword without hesitation, and Joshua took the blow and stepped back.
The Runcandel and Wraith Squad members who had just started fighting glanced at Jin and Joshua.
"Youngest, do you know what you're doing right now?"

"As I just said, I'm questioning your responsibility for obstructing the mission. 2nd Rank, you should have informed me and my second brother about the information on the 2nd Tower when Kinzelo started the terror and the situation changed rapidly."
Unlike Joshua, who was soaked in anger and barely spoke in a low voice, Jin had a calm voice.
"I don't know what you're believing to do this. Youngest, you should know. If you hit me now, you will lose much more than you can compare with me."
"We'll see when the situation is over."
"Unlike me, you won't have another chance."
At that remark, Jin chuckled and laughed.
"Well, I know. Unlike the 2nd Rank clone, I only have one life. So, isn't your role clear?"
Hand everything over to me and die for the family.

Jin continued his words and swung his sword again. They seemed to be merely engaged in a power struggle, but the highly concentrated aura on their swords was ready to explode at any moment if one side gave way.
"Whether you spread a volcano like that time or use another method, distract the enemies and buy time somehow. I will secure the blueprint and take it to the Sword Garden."
Boom-!
An explosion occurred in Bradamante as Joshua's aura was pushed back.
Joshua couldn't perform at his best due to the intense battle with the Wraith Squad he had just fought. He stepped back to take Jin's next sword and hastily corrected his posture.
It was a strange battle.
On the battlefield divided into two, Runcandel and Zephyr fought at the front, and Runcandel fought against Runcandel in the back.
"Nenom...!"

"Shouldn't you have focused more on training? Three years ago, at the Blue Bird Army Road, you were definitely stronger than me, 2nd Rank. Even considering that you were fighting the Wraith Squad, your sword lacks depth. Reinforcements will arrive soon, meaning there's no time. Make a decision quickly, 2nd Rank."
Joshua's sword being blunt wasn't just because of physical exhaustion.
He was in turmoil.
Not only Jin had been tormented by variables in the Sota Desert. Joshua was also physically and mentally exhausted by the sudden and continuous variables and unknowns.
"Damn it, it's not enough to face the Wraith Squad as soon as we enter the tower, but also this...!"
The key created by the prophet had neutralized the barrier of the magic tower, but they hadn't even reached the vault yet.
Joshua was also in the midst of his dilemma. He wondered whether it would be better for him to buy time and leave his back to Jane.
As Jin said, there was no time.
And if Jin didn't back down, and they continued to fight like this, there was a high probability that the Runcandel would lose the ranks and the Black Knights without gaining anything.
'Besides, if Jin is captured or killed here, my prophecy would be wrong. That's not likely, though. This could be just a piece of the prophecy or a turning point.'
Gritting his teeth, blood flowed from his clenched jaw.
Though their forms and methods might differ, and their hearts might not all be righteous or excellent.
Of course, all the ranks put their family first and loved them. Among them, Joshua was a rank who had been obsessed with the Runcandel.
He was always a person who made choices for the Runcandel.
At least that's what he thought.
'I must... listen to the youngest.'
From the moment the youngest first spoke, he should have responded without crossing swords with him.

It was just that his judgment was blurred for a moment, feeling that one emotion, which had been horribly damaged for a long time due to the people he most wanted to resemble and reach, was collapsing once again.
Pride.
This time, Joshua decided to give up that emotion for the family.
Swish!
Joshua took the key out of his pocket and threw it to Jin.
"This is the vault key. Thanks to it, we could ignore the barrier."
"Interesting. Where did you get it?"
"I don't think I need to tell you that much. Don't doubt whether the item is genuine. Well, you can read magic, so that shouldn't be a problem."
The vault key was a kind of artifact.
The flow of magic running inside the key had many similarities to the barrier outside.
Besides, only Zephyr could embed such complex magic in an object the size of a key.
"You had this, and you were planning to use us as bait?"
"I believed that you and Diphus would be able to escape and return while I obtained the blueprint. The guardian deity of the family is with us as well."
"Huh."
Jin sighed.

"You made a decent choice in the end, but I have to tell you this: if this mission fails, know that it's because of your greed. You used the clones, but you put the real ranks and Black Knights in danger like this?"
"Greed, think what you want. But, if I didn't love the family, I wouldn't have given you the key now."
Joshua turned around and said, believing that Jin, who had been pointing a sword at him just moments ago, wouldn't stab him in the back.
Jin's actions also stemmed from the belief that instead of killing his own clone and avenging a petty grudge, he would do something for the family.

"Go to the vault right now. As you've probably already guessed, the fact that only four Wraith Squad members are left here isn't a trap. I don't know the exact reason, but I can't help but think it's because they're preparing for Kinzelo. So, there must be a blueprint in the vault."
The aura surrounding Joshua's sword began to emit a brighter light. Having made a decision and cleared his doubts, he regained his true power.
"…I'll signal you once I secure the blueprint. Escape with the Black Knight then."
"I'll do that."
Jane glanced at the two's atmosphere and let out a sigh of relief inside.
'I couldn't hear exactly what conversation they had, but looking at the flow, it seems that the 2nd Rank will buy time, and the 12th Rank will get the blueprint.'
Her heart was lightened by the fact that the Runcandel ranks wouldn't kill each other in enemy territory.
Jane and Joshua were not only pushed back by the Wraith Squad.
Even in the numerical disadvantage, they had already considerably drained the Wraith Squad's stamina, and Murakan and Diphus were dealing damage to them relatively easily.

'All that's left is to hold on somehow. So that the 12th Rank can complete the mission! It would be great if the 12th Rank leaves either the 4th Rank or the guardian deity. Even if everyone leaves, the battle with the Wraith Squad will be much easier than before….'
Just as Jane thought that far.
Boom, boom….
Suddenly, a heavy rumble was heard from the outside of the iron door where they were standing.
It was a rumble that seemed like a giant creature was approaching with big strides. The battle stopped for a moment as if on cue, and everyone's eyes were on the iron door.
The owner of the rumble entered the hall.
It was a giant man dressed in perfectly tailored formal attire. Massive and solid muscles that could not be hidden by clothing, looking hardly like a human body.
He was Zephyr's second-ranked butler and Sandra's exclusive butler, Hedo.
In his hand, wearing a white glove, was the head of a man dripping with blood.
"There were some Wraith Squad members who were not completely foolish."
With a thud, he dropped the man's head to the floor, took out a cigarette, and Hedo spoke.
